recordedAgainst.target: production Identity Toolkit and Secure Token REST and the declared SDKs (firebase-admin for Node, the Web SDK in Node), Identity Platform sandbox; action codes from the Admin sendOobCode with returnOobLink (nothing is mailed)
recordedAgainst.note: Two recordings per program. A configuration is recorded without the members other lanes own (mfa, multiTenant, blockingFunctions; scope decisions K9 and K10) and with key material as placeholders (K12). SDK rows are `{sdk: ok, value}` or `{sdk: error, code, message}`. Tokens are recorded as their claims with times relative to iat; action links as their query parameters. `second` holds the other recording of rows that differed.
